needs_atom.missing: A per-candidate name-equality filter against other objects: 'search your library for a card with the same name as another creature you control' needs FAtom 'the candidate's name equals the name of some object matching <filter>' (here: another creature you control, FAnd(CONTROLLER_IS YOU, TYPE_EQ Creature, FNot(IS_SOURCE)) on the battlefield). NAME_EQ takes only a literal string; NAME_CHOSEN needs a separate CHOOSE_NAME step the card does not have (naming first commits to one name before the search: a different, weaker decision); NAME_PARTITION_COUNT_GE is a board-state group count with no candidate ('no pairwise name-equality vocabulary', quantity.py). The rest is expressible: ETB + OptionalEffect(Seq(SEARCH to hand, REVEAL, SHUFFLE)).
